name: io.github.ackeescreenshoter.android.activity.FeedbackActivity
description: When the device is shaken while Ackee's reporting feature is active, the SDK captures the current screen and opens this Activity with app and device details. Users can add a message, choose another image, and send the report.
disableEffect: Ackee's shake-to-report screen cannot open or submit a report, and triggering the flow can cause an app launch error.
